protocol.scope: All eight original cases for this model within the full five-model, 40-case comparison.

arms.B: Native future commands, commanded history, original causal endpoint observer
arms.S: Full-horizon native identity/sham command encoding, commanded history
arms.L: Existing correction arm and commanded history; explicit legacy actuator as documented
arms.M: Baseline future policy and measured memory

protocol.reuse: Only complete baseline-arm outputs with the correct model/scene/seed, memory policy and exact original generated-source hashes (including children); copied source equivalence already qualified. Decode lossless RGB, verify retained raw hash and horizon, bind artifact hashes. Otherwise generate a fresh matched arm.
protocol.execution: First full-horizon B/S identity; then all eight B/L comparisons; only then M and complete triplets. Scientific/registration failures retained. A memory failure cannot suppress already completed legacy comparisons.
protocol.gates: Exact raw B/S full-horizon identity on the first prespecified case; exact B/L and B/L/M pre-intervention RGB and matching intrinsics for every scored case.
protocol.primary_metric: Mean fixed-time position from the original first-affected frame to the original native endpoint. Rotation, endpoint, whole-rollout, quality, unavailable registration and failures remain visible.
protocol.legacy_caveat: Preserve the actual legacy host/controller and its observer acceptance behavior. No newly fitted gain, bounded non-reversal rule or measured-memory rewrite is added to L. DreamX uses its separately documented corrected common host.
protocol.guards: 4 GiB launch / 2 GiB runtime disk reserve; 2 GiB host-memory reserve; shared GPU locks
